title: Choose crops by food value, time and risk
subcategory: Choose crops by food value, time and risk
summary: Balance quick harvests, reliable staples, nutrition and storage value.
steps: Write the household goal: fresh greens, flavour, calories, protein contribution, storage or seed continuity.
Score each candidate crop for local suitability, days to harvest, water, space, skill and preservation needs.
Include fast crops and slower high-yield crops instead of depending on only one type.
Prefer crops the household will actually eat and can prepare safely.
Review yield and labour after harvest; replace poor performers next cycle.
